svg.title: External match load and observation coverage
svg.desc: 20 selected A-League 2024/25 fixtures · Detected positions only; incomplete broadcast exposure Workload labels give pooled observed player-minutes. Rates do not fill missing time or measure fitness. Median visibility: 42.6%; 1/623 records reach 80%. The 80% reference gates rolling windows, not entire records.
